instructions: LintCrux lints Verilog, SystemVerilog and VHDL with the engines a project configures. Call lint with a .lintcrux project, or with source files, for every finding with its rule, severity and file:line. A run in which an engine failed, timed out or was missing has the outcome engine_error and is never a clean result. Call rule for a rule's default severity and help link, and waivers for the waivers in force. Cite each finding as file:line. Waivers and baselines are a person's decision: never edit one to make a run clean.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Lint a design with its configured engines (Verilator, Verible, Slang, Yosys, GHDL, svlint, CDC). Returns findings with rule, severity and file:line. A failed or missing engine fails the run; it is never reported clean.

new_only.description: Fail the gate on findings absent from the baseline.

tools.name: rule
tools.description: What a lint rule checks, its default severity and help link, by the engineId/ruleId a finding gives. Only cdc and constraints rules have a sentence.

tools.name: waivers
tools.description: The waivers in force for a project: rule, scope, reason, author and expiry. Read only; a waiver is a person's decision.
